//: cleanUrls makes /delete-account resolve to public/delete-account.html and
Set explicitly rather than relying on Vercel's default because both URLs are
submitted to the Google Play Console. Play rejects a Data safety submission
whose account-deletion URL does not resolve, and the existing in-app and
footer links point at /privacy-policy.html, which this keeps working via the
trailingSlash is pinned for the same reason: leaving it unset lets the
platform default change underneath a URL that external reviewers depend on.
